definitions.explanation: A company that produces and distributes books, magazines, or other printed materials.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大手|おおて}→大手：12171_oote⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{出版社|しゅっぱんしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{勤|つと}めている→勤める：00902_tsutomeru⟧。
examples.english: I work at a major publishing company.

examples.japanese: ⟦{原稿|げんこう}→原稿：00064_genkou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{出版社|しゅっぱんしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{持|も}ち{込|こ}んだ→持ち込む：04226_mochikomu⟧。
examples.english: I brought my manuscript to a publisher.

examples.english: That publisher mainly produces textbooks and reference books.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{出版|しゅっぱん}→出版：03222_shuppan⟧ (publishing) + ⟦{社|しゃ}→〜社：04660_sha⟧ (company). Covers publishers of books, magazines, manga, and other print or digital media.

MAJOR JAPANESE PUBLISHERS:
- {講談社|こうだんしゃ}: Kodansha
- {集英社|しゅうえいしゃ}: Shueisha
- {新潮社|しんちょうしゃ}: Shinchosha
- {小学館|しょうがくかん}: Shogakukan

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{大手|おおて}→大手：12171_oote⟧{出版社|しゅっぱんしゃ}: major publisher
- {出版社|しゅっぱんしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{持|も}ち{込|こ}む→持ち込む：04226_mochikomu⟧: bring a manuscript to a publisher
- {出版社|しゅっぱんしゃ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: publish through a publisher
